progression.narrative: The performance opens on B3 and dwells most on Gb in Phrase 1. Phrase 2 (0:39.6) introduces A, centred on E. The line peaks at A4 (439.6 Hz) at 0:55.5. It closes on E4, not the tonic (G4 → G4 → Gb4 → Gb4 → G4 → E4).
